coordinate_units: Unchanged source numeric units; no mesh position correction (second-model control measured 1.0656x, see SecondModelControl README).

profile_evidence.basis: Both inverse-bind-compatible rules fit the model; the animation data selects SSC0. In every clip with animated pincer-leg scale, the three bit-0 segments (upleg, midleg, loleg) carry the same local X stretch per frame (worst relative spread 3.1%) with Y = Z = 1/X (worst |X*Y-1| 0.032): the signature of a Maya stretchy-IK chain authored with segment scale compensation. Under SSC0 the world chain length grows by the keyed stretch (toxic_crab_death RT: keyed 1.506, chain 1.47); full inheritance compounds it (2.04).
profile_evidence.consistency: Bones without flag bit 0 (head, jaw, brows, eyes, pincer ball/claw) are the ones a rig leaves inheriting parent squash; the same SSC0 adapter rule is already used for every unambiguous clip and the Sheepinator profile.
profile_evidence.scope: Selects the authored-rig interpretation for this exact source model; not a capture-verified in-game claim. The pincer-leg stretch (up to ~1.5x in death/knockback clips) is authored squash-and-stretch and is kept unedited.
